# Contributing to GOAT

Thank you for your interest in contributing to GOAT!

We welcome contributions in multiple ways — from reporting bugs to suggesting new features or submitting improvements.

### Reporting Bugs

If you encounter an issue or unexpected behavior, please open a **Bug Report** using the template provided. Include all relevant details, such as:

- Steps to reproduce
- Expected vs actual behavior
- Screenshots or logs if applicable

### Suggesting Features

If you have an idea for a new feature or enhancement, please open a **Feature Request** using the provided template. Include:

- Clear description of the functionality
- Acceptance criteria or expected behavior
- Any notes, references, or context

### General Guidelines

- Check if an issue already exists to avoid duplicates
- Be concise and precise in your descriptions
- Maintainers may ask for clarifications before merging any Pull Requests

We appreciate your contributions — every improvement helps make GOAT more useful and accessible!
